goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m thinking about organising a little get-together with some friends and was wondering if your place is good for a group. We’re looking for somewhere that has a nice vibe and tasty food.
That’s great to hear! There are five of us, and we’re all pretty excited to catch up over a good meal. Is that number alright for a booking this weekend?
Thanks for checking! We were thinking of coming in this Sunday — it’s always nice to end the weekend on a high note with good company and food. Does Sunday work for your bookings?
That’s a handy range of times! We’d like to book for 6:30pm, since it gives us a chance to chat and still get home before it’s too late. Is that slot available for five people this Sunday?

Thanks for confirming! None of us have any allergies or dietary restrictions, so we’re all set there. You can put the booking under Marcus Bell — he’s the organiser and will be arriving with the group.
Perfect, thank you so much! We’re looking forward to it and I’ll let everyone know the booking is sorted. Have a great day, and see you Sunday! [END OF CALL]
